mapper.select: SELECT b.no, b.title, b.writer, b.view_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_reply r WHERE r.board_no = b.no) AS reply_cnt FROM project_board b ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.title, b.writer, b.view_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_reply r WHERE r.board_no = b.no) AS reply_cnt FROM project_board b WHERE
b.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
(b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR b.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
b.writer LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
b.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY b.no DESC

SELECT b.no, b.title, b.writer, b.view_cnt, TO_CHAR(b.reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_reply r WHERE r.board_no = b.no) AS reply_cnt FROM project_board b WHERE b.writer = #{writer} ORDER BY b.no DESC
SELECT no, title, writer, content, view_cnt, TO_CHAR(reg_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_date FROM project_board WHERE no = #{no}
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_project_board_no.nextval FROM dual
